title: Dashboard enhancements and bug fixes
body:
* **Data-exploration controls in dataset results and metric view preview**: The dataset results table and the metric view preview grid now include column pinning and formatting, search, a column explorer, natural-language filtering, and a selection details panel. See [View the results table](/aws/en/dashboards/manage/data-modeling/datasets#view-results-table).
* **Include-style level of detail (LOD) expressions in the metric view editor**: The metric view editor now supports include-style LOD expressions. See [Finer level of detail](/aws/en/uc-semantics/metric-views/level-of-detail#finer-lod).
* **Ignore filters on a widget**: You can now configure a dashboard widget to ignore selected dashboard filters, so those filters don't affect the widget while they continue to apply to the rest of the page.
* **Genie Code stall fix**: Fixed an issue where Genie Code made unnecessary turns between edits, which made the agent appear to stall.
* **Field labels error fix**: Fixed an issue where selecting a field for labels caused a dashboard error.
* **Data reference picker fix**: Fixed an issue where the `@` data reference picker displayed a transparent background.
